statements.statement: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for this member
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and I25.10
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events in an outpatient setting
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered
